policy.revision_note: v1.1 was declared after the initial diagnostic pass and before the final executed run. It adds direct 210/294-session neighbourhood variants for the three 252-session qualification definitions that triggered robustness testing. These variants are SECONDARY_TRIGGERED_NEIGHBOURHOOD, do not enter the 84-test primary FDR family, and cannot replace their central specification.

regimes.market_volatility: GLOBAL_ALL_WORLD trailing 63-session volatility above versus below its prior expanding median
regimes.rates: A2 SONIA fixing above versus below its value 63 canonical sessions earlier
regimes.dispersion: cross-sectional standard deviation of 21-session returns above versus below its prior expanding median
regimes.us_leadership: US_BROAD_LARGE_CAP 63-session return above versus below median non-US GEOGRAPHY return

dependency_tests.ex_us_technology_semiconductors: exclude US_NASDAQ_100 plus authoritative US-technology and semiconductor-industry families
dependency_tests.ex_best_full_period_family: ex-post diagnostic only; rank families by annualised geometric mean of valid daily returns
dependency_tests.ex_top_five_full_period_families: ex-post diagnostic only; rank families by annualised geometric mean of valid daily returns
dependency_tests.ex_recent_inception: exclude family/date observations with fewer than 756 accrued valid returns
dependency_tests.ex_high_volatility: exclude contemporaneous top quintile of 63-session realised volatility

criteria: positive mean IC in at least four of six headline cells
positive median IC in at least four of six headline cells
average headline mean IC greater than 0.01
at least one headline HAC p-value survives BH FDR at q <= 0.10
positive top-minus-bottom spread in at least four of six headline cells
at least one headline spread has HAC p <= 0.10
average quantile monotonicity score at least 0.50
CORE-only mean IC positive in at least four of six matched cells
category-neutral mean IC positive in at least four of six matched cells
positive 42-session mean IC in at least three of FULL, PRE_2020, FROM_2020, RECENT_5Y and RECENT_3Y
mean IC remains positive after both US-technology and top-five-winner exclusions
21-session rank autocorrelation is at least 0.25 or leader-above-median persistence is at least 0.55
parameter-neighbourhood evidence is directionally stable where the signal has a declared central lookback; otherwise this criterion is NOT_APPLICABLE and excluded from the denominator

classification_rule.RESEARCH_CANDIDATE: at least 75 percent of applicable criteria, including FDR survival, with no critical timing/data failure
classification_rule.SECONDARY: at least 58 percent but less than 75 percent of applicable criteria, or at least 75 percent without FDR survival
classification_rule.WEAK: at least 42 percent but less than 58 percent of applicable criteria
classification_rule.REJECTED: less than 42 percent of applicable criteria or wrong economic direction

candidate_assessment.diagnostic_target_rule: Run regime, dispersion, dependency, bootstrap and weekday-perturbation diagnostics for every RESEARCH_CANDIDATE; if none qualify, use the three highest-scoring non-rejected primary signals without promoting them.

decision_rule.UKACTIVE_A3_WEAK_OR_REGIME_DEPENDENT_SIG: no RESEARCH_CANDIDATE and at least one SECONDARY or WEAK signal with coherent conditional evidence
decision_rule.UKACTIVE_A3_NO_ROBUST_SIGNAL: all primary signals REJECTED or effects are isolated/unstable
decision_rule.UKACTIVE_A3_FAIL_DATA_OR_METHOD: critical correctness failure or insufficient valid cross-section
